At point (500, 400), all three bands cover that location:
- alpha covers x=300–700, y=300–420, z-index 2
- beta covers x=340–740, y=340–460, z-index 4
- gamma covers x=380–780, y=380–500, z-index 3

Since they share the same stacking context (all absolutely positioned children of root), the element with the highest z-index paints on top. Beta's z-index of 4 is the largest, so its background (rgb(68, 85, 102)) is what the viewer sees.

ANSWER: root>beta
